ResourceHeader.ResourceName: Hinode SOT-FG Level 0 Filtergram FITS Data (FG)

RevisionEvent.Note: Initial metadata creation and publication. SY

ResourceHeader.Description: The Hinode Solar Optical Telescope Filtergraph (SOT-FG) Level 0 FG (simple) FITS data product consists of uncalibrated, two-dimensional filtergram images. It is the product identified by DataCode FG, OBS_TYPE='FG (simple)', and GEN_ID=1, and is distinct from other SOT-FG products such as focus scans, magnetograms, and polarization sequences. Images are obtained with the Broadband Filter Imager (BFI; FITS INSTRUME='SOT/WB') and Narrowband Filter Imager (NFI; FITS INSTRUME='SOT/NB') in various passbands used to observe the solar photosphere and chromosphere. The Level 0 data retain detector-oriented images before scientific calibration. Image dimensions and angular pixel scales vary with observing settings, including subframing and binning; typical unbinned scales are approximately 0.05448 arcsec per pixel for BFI and 0.08 arcsec per pixel for NFI. The FITS header identifies the observing passband, detector, exposure, and image sampling.

Parameter.Name: Solar Filtergram Images
Parameter.Description: Two-dimensional Level 0 SOT-FG filtergram images stored in the FITS Primary HDU. The images are acquired in multiple discrete BFI and NFI passbands, rather than over a continuous wavelength range. The observing passband is indicated by the FITS header keyword WAVE.
